                                   Resolution 2022-16
                      Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors
                        RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT
            FOR THE PURCHASE OF 2 FIRE DEPARTMENT VEHICLES

WHEREAS, Girdwood Fire and Rescue Inc (GFR) needs to replace Utility 41 and Chief 41 vehicles in order to
continue providing Fire Service to the Girdwood Valley, for which the Girdwood Valley Service Area is
responsible; and

WHEREAS, the vehicles currently in use by GFR are beyond their lifespan and do not meet current safety
standards of fire command units; and

WHEREAS, GFR will provide an additional $7,000 for the replacement from donations and fire deployment
revenue,

THEREFORE, the Girdwood Board of Supervisors supports the purchase of new vehicles to replace Utility 41
and Chief 41 at a cost not to exceed $200,000 (TWO HUNDRED THOUSAND DOLLARS) from the GFR 406
Capital Account.


PASSED AND APPROVED by a vote of 5 to 0 this 18th day of July 2022.



Guy Wade
GBOS Fire Department Chair
